clarified_messages.content: Hey, I'm finally here. The café isn't too crowded.
Awesome. I'm just getting off the train, so I'll be there soon. Have you seen Sam yet?
No, not yet. I think Sam said he'd get here around now.
Should we grab that table by the window?
Sure, I'm moving there.
Oh, I just bumped into her—Jules is already here!
Great, ask her if she got the menu I sent earlier.
She says she got it, but couldn't open that pdf.
I'll resend it to her in a different format. By the way, did you check if they have gluten-free options at this place?
Checking now... Yes, there are a few, but not much for vegans.
Should we try that Italian place near the park instead? I think they can handle all the allergies.
Good idea. Is it open tomorrow evening?
Let me check... Yes, but they only have a late slot, like 8:30 PM.
That might work. Did you ask him if that's too late for his kid?
Not yet. I'll text Tom now.
Also, can you confirm with that coordinator at the Italian place if the kitchen can avoid nuts for Zoe?
Already calling her. I'll let you know in a bit.
Tell her we're a party of six and have dietary cards ready.
Will do. Should we invite Anna too, or is she out of town?
She's traveling now, but back tomorrow afternoon.
Perfect. I'll add her to the list. Anyone else we're missing?
I think that's everyone. Can you bring that big invitation card you made last time so we can fill it in?
I left it at my place, but I'll grab it before coming over tomorrow.
Great. Let's confirm the final place once you hear back from the restaurant.
Sounds good. Also, Tom replied—8:30 works for his family.
And Zoe messaged me. She wants to double-check the ingredient list again.
Can you send me her list? I'll forward it to the coordinator.
Sure, forwarding it now.
Did Maya say if she needed a ride, or is she walking over?
She's driving—said she'd pick up Anna from the station.
Great, the more the merrier. By the way, this place plays live jazz, but only on Thursdays.
That's too bad, we miss it by a day. Also, did you notice the traffic’s crazy around here tonight?
Yep, the subway was packed. Hopefully tomorrow it's better.
Do you want me to pre-order some appetizers for us?
Let’s wait until everyone confirms their choices.
Sam just walked in. He says hi.
Give him the updated menu when you get a chance.
Will do. Anything else we need to check?
Oh, ask Jules about dessert—she’s allergic to eggs, right?
She says yes, but she’ll bring her own.
Alright. I’ll let the coordinator know not to plan any egg-based dessert.
Thanks. I’ll update the group chat once you get the final confirmation.
Okay, I’ll text you once I hear back from her.
Sounds good. See you tomorrow at that place.
See you then. Remember to bring those dietary cards.
Already in my bag.
You’re always prepared!
Got to be when half the group could end up in the ER.
Haha, true. I checked the weather—looks clear tomorrow.
Nice. Let's hope it stays that way.
